maria (eng-platform): Heads-up — Support asked for a temporary burst raise for org 'acme-corp' for a customer demo tomorrow. We don't have a clear runbook for granting short-lived quota overrides that are auditable and reversible. Need input: process, console UX, API, and guardrails. TL;DR: request -> approve -> 1h TTL default -> audit log. Thoughts?

devon (eng-platform): +1 on runbook. Suggest we create an API endpoint that issues an 'ephemeral allowance' token tied to org_id and admin who approved. TTL config, max boost % per tier. Minimal scope: per-org quota increase, not per-key.

simon (eng-platform): prefer per-key rather than per-org for demos — lower blast radius. Can we do both? default to per-key with org fallback.

alyssa (sales): For demos we need a self-serve UI where AMs can request a raise; approval should be from SRE/Support only. Also need a checkbox 'auditable reason' so CS can log justification.

ryan (oncall): Oncall here — if we allow self-serve requests we need rate-limited approval page and 2FA for approvals > X tokens. Also rollback button + automatic expiry. SLO risk if we don't cap bursts.

devon (eng-platform): Implementation sketch: POST /admin/overrides with {org_id, key_id?, delta_rps, ttl_seconds, approver, reason}. Response returns override_id and token. Store in overrides table and attach to realtime routing. Code snippet: ```http
POST /admin/overrides
{
  "org_id": "org_acme",
  "key_id": "key_abc123",
  "delta_rps": 100,
  "ttl_seconds": 3600,
  "approver": "maria",
  "reason": "sales demo"
}
```

support-bot: audit-log saved: override_id=ovr_20260301_001 created by maria for org_acme key_abc123 ttl=3600.

maria (eng-platform): Questions: 1) Do we enforce pre-approval limits (e.g., only allow up to 2x baseline)? 2) Do we require an approval chain (support leader sign-off) for > 4x? 3) Where in console UX should request live — quota page or each API key page?

simon (eng-platform): I'd enforce a hard cap (say 3x) at router layer. Anything >3x flags an 'escalation required' and sets state=needs_manual_review.

alyssa (sales): Sales prefers request from the customer page (per-key) but fine with org-level if defaulting to per-key. We need email notification to AM on approval.

ryan (oncall): Also add an emergency 'safe-mode' toggle for SRE to instantly revoke all overrides globally in case of abuse.

maria (eng-platform): I'll draft a KB for Support with step-by-step and add console mocks. Action items: @devon to sketch API + DB schema, @simon to scope router changes, @ryan to add revoke control, @alyssa to define sales flow. I'll post prototype by EOD. :+1:
